level.setting: A mysterious underwater trench hidden beneath a remote island, where the ocean floor is littered with ancient ruins and glowing bioluminescent coral. Strange energy pulses from the depths, drawing the geomancer into the heart of the unknown.

encounters.hazard: Sudden shifts in water pressure and bioluminescent algae that obscure vision.

pickup.name: Coral Core
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of player's health

encounters.trigger: The player must navigate the labyrinth and defeat the Tentacle Drifter to unlock a hidden path leading deeper into the trench.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars and shifting platforms guarded by the Warden.

pickup.name: Abyssal Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new geomantic ability: 'Tidal Pulse' (area-of-effect damage)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Crustacean Warden, the Abyssal Resonator activates, revealing an ancient doorway leading to the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: Constant seismic activity, shifting terrain, and a massive energy core that pulses with unknown power.

pickup.name: Echo of the Deep
pickup.effect: Increases player damage by 30% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Sentinel is awakened by the player's presence, and its weakness is only exploitable with the power of the Abyssal Resonator.

boss.name: The Abyssal Sentinel
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core beneath the Sentinel by using the Abyssal Resonator in conjunction with Tidal Pulse to destabilize its form.

level.objective: Reach the Heart of the Abyss and defeat the Abyssal Sentinel.
level.reward: Echo of the Deep and access to the geomantic ability 'Tidal Pulse'.

encounters.hazard: Beware of sudden current shifts.

pickup.name: Luminous Shell
pickup.effect: Increases player's movement speed by 20% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon destroying the Anemone, the coral wall ahead cracks open, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Enemy may ambush from shadows.

pickup.name: Tidestone Charm
pickup.effect: Temporarily slows enemy movement by 30% when equipped.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shark, a deep rumbling shakes the trench, revealing the entrance to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Enemy can summon smaller enemies if not dealt with quickly.

pickup.name: Coral Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player health when picked up.

encounters.trigger: The Leviathan awakens only after the player has passed the first two encounters, testing their growing power.

boss.name: Leviathan
boss.weakness: Tidestone Charm (Slow & Reflect) combined with Tidal Trident (Electric Shock)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan to restore balance to the reef.

level.objective: Protect the coral reef from the Leviathan by clearing the path through the reef sanctuary.
level.reward: Coral Heart (heal) and Luminous Shell (speed boost) to aid in future dives.

level.setting: The Abyssal Trenches - a deep, shadowy trench filled with bioluminescent coral and ancient ruins. The water is thick with silt, making visibility scarce, and strange, guttural echoes echo through the deep.

encounters.hazard: Sudden surges of dark water reduce player movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Coral Fragment
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of player's health. Grants +15% damage to all enemies for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadowfin Warden causes the coral to crack and release a powerful pulse, triggering a rift that opens the path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Dark water currents pull the player toward the center of the rift, dealing 5 damage per second for 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Ancient Tidal Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's weapon damage by 25% for 15 seconds. Can be used once.

encounters.trigger: The Vile Abyssal Eel's death causes the rift to collapse, releasing a burst of energy that opens a portal to the final encounter.

enemy.name: The Abyssal Warden
enemy.weakness: Ancient Tidal Core (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The water becomes violently unstable, causing random whirlpools that deal 10 damage on contact.

pickup.name: Heart of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Fully restores player's health and grants immunity to all enemy debuffs for 10 seconds. Cannot be used again.

encounters.trigger: The Abyssal Warden is bound by ancient chains that can only be broken by the Ancient Tidal Core. Upon defeating the boss, the chains break, unleashing a torrent of light that clears the trench and allows escape.

boss.name: The Abyssal Warden
boss.weakness: Ancient Tidal Core (pickup from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of the Warden by using the Ancient Tidal Core in the final phase.

level.objective: Survive the depths of the trench, defeat the three ancient guardians, and finally confront the Abyssal Warden who guards the heart of the abyss.
level.reward: Heart of the Abyss (restores full health and grants immunity to debuffs).

level.setting: A labyrinth of ancient coral reefs and submerged ruins. The water is dark and thick with debris, and the sound of distant explosions echoes through the trench.

encounters.hazard: Strong currents and collapsing rock formations that damage player if not avoided.

pickup.name: Tidal Core
pickup.effect: Increases lightning damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Leviathan, the water clears momentarily, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Periodic electrical storms and ghostly apparitions that slow player movement.

pickup.name: Coral Fragment
pickup.effect: Restores 30% of player health upon pickup.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Revenant, the water becomes violently agitated, signaling the approach of the final boss.

enemy.name: Leviathan King
enemy.weakness: Coral Fragment (health restoration to aid in boss fight)

encounters.hazard: Lava vents and pressure spikes that damage the player if not timed correctly.

pickup.name: Stormheart Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful lightning storm attack (one-time use).

encounters.trigger: Leviathan King's awakening is triggered by the coral fragment's energy signature, causing the trench to collapse and revealing the boss arena.

boss.name: Leviathan King
boss.weakness: Stormheart Crystal (triggering a massive lightning storm that overwhelms the boss)
boss.victory_condition: Defeating the Leviathan King with the Stormheart Crystal in hand.

level.objective: Survive the trench and defeat the Leviathan King using the pickups collected from previous encounters.
level.reward: Access to the Sunken Archive and a permanent 15% increase to lightning damage.

encounters.hazard: Dark Currents (slows movement by 30%)

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Core
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by +1

encounters.trigger: Break the light orb above the archway to reveal the enemy

encounters.hazard: Falling debris (reduces player health by 1 on hit)

pickup.name: Echo Amplifier
pickup.effect: Player can use an ability to reveal hidden paths

encounters.trigger: Use Echo Amplifier to trigger hidden trap, revealing the enemy

encounters.hazard: Pressure plates (activates enemy attacks when stepped on)

pickup.name: Shadow Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final escape passage

encounters.trigger: Echo Amplifier reveals the hidden chamber and activates the boss

boss.name: The Abyssal Warden
boss.victory_condition: Use Echo Amplifier to disrupt the Warden's resonance field

level.objective: Escape the sunken city by navigating through three encounters and defeating the final boss
level.reward: Shadow Resonator - unlocks access to deeper underwater regions

level.setting: A drowned ancient city, once a volcanic forge, now a labyrinth of coral-encrusted ruins, geothermal vents, and molten pockets trapped under water. The water is thick with sulfur, and the ruins are unstable, shifting and collapsing with each passing moment.

encounters.location: The first chamber: a cavern with glowing magma veins beneath the water, guarded by a colossal eel-like creature.
encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt unpredictably, damaging the player if not timed properly.

pickup.name: Molten Core Shard
pickup.effect: When equipped, increases fire damage by 15% and grants immunity to fire-based attacks for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Hydro Serpent, a hidden door opens, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.location: A flooded coliseum with collapsing columns and shifting platforms, where the Tidal Warden, a guardian of the ruins, awakens.
encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and collapses in random sections, forcing the player to navigate carefully.

pickup.name: Coral Core Crystal
pickup.effect: When used, it creates a shield for 8 seconds that absorbs 50% of all elemental damage.

encounters.trigger: After the Tidal Warden is defeated, a hidden mechanism is activated, opening a path to the final chamber.

encounters.location: The core chamber of the ruins: a massive, unstable geothermal chamber, with lava flowing through the water and the Leviathan stirring from slumber.
encounters.hazard: The entire environment is unstable. Walls collapse, lava bursts, and the Leviathan's attacks can trigger chain reactions.

pickup.name: Pyrothos Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Infernal Storm' ultimate ability, summoning a fiery whirlwind that deals massive AoE damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan with the Molten Core Shard grants the Pyrothos Relic and unlocks the escape route to the surface.

boss.name: Chaos Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Use the Molten Core Shard during the final phase to trigger a fiery explosion that weakens the boss significantly.

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing ruins and defeat the Chaos Leviathan to escape the drowned city before the final collapse.
level.reward: Pyrothos Relic, which unlocks a permanent fire-based ultimate ability and a powerful fire shield.

level.setting: A submerged, abandoned research facility on the ocean floor, cloaked in eternal darkness with flickering bioluminescent signs and thick, murky water.

encounters.hazard: Strong currents and low oxygen levels

pickup.name: Resonant Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's weapon damage by 20% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: Upon destroying the first tentacle, the facility's systems reboot and seal the entrance, forcing the warden deeper into the structure.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling tiles and corrosive water leakage

pickup.name: Cryo-Module
pickup.effect: Freezes enemies in place for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Mawbeast triggers a system lockdown, activating security drones and opening the path to the core chamber.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing environment, toxic gas pockets, and unstable pressure plates

pickup.name: Abyssal Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks final chamber for permanent access

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan Warden grants access to the Abyssal Key, revealing the facility's true purpose and allowing the warden to escape.

boss.name: The Abyssal Warden (Ancient Leviathan)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with Cryo-Module active to freeze it long enough to deliver the final blow

level.objective: Survive the facility, defeat all three encounters, and escape the collapsing structure with the Abyssal Key.
level.reward: Abyssal Key, Resonant Core (permanent upgrade), Cryo-Module (permanent upgrade), and a 10% increase in maximum health.

encounters.hazard: Fog of Illusion (confuses player direction)

pickup.name: Bubble of Clarity
pickup.effect: Increases player vision range by 50%

encounters.trigger: Defeat Glimmerfin to clear the fog and reveal a path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Echoing Whispers (distracts player with illusions)

pickup.name: Shimmering Scale
pickup.effect: Adds 5% damage reflection to player's weapon

encounters.trigger: Defeat Mistshell to stop the echoes and unlock a hidden tunnel leading to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Illusionary Maze (changes layout every 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Crown of Clarity
pickup.effect: Unlocks a permanent illusion-shattering ability

encounters.trigger: Defeat the King of Reflections to restore balance to the sea and complete the level.

boss.name: King of Reflections
boss.victory_condition: Defeat King of Reflections with the Shimmering Scale pickup active to reveal the Crown of Clarity.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical underwater kingdom, defeat the three encounters, and defeat the King of Reflections to restore peace.

level.setting: a dense, overgrown rainforest at night, with bioluminescent plants, eerie sounds, and sudden flashes of light from unseen creatures.

encounters.location: A narrow, vine-choked path near the edge of the jungle

enemy.name: Vinebound Viper
enemy.weakness: The Tribal Flail's chain is resistant to entanglement and can sever the vines

encounters.hazard: The path collapses underfoot, forcing the player to fight while balancing on unstable ground.

pickup.name: Stamina Crystal
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's stamina, allowing for a short burst of speed and dodging.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Viper, the ground cracks open, revealing a hidden path that leads to the next encounter.

encounters.location: A forgotten temple, half-buried in the jungle, with glowing symbols and stone statues

enemy.name: Shadow Stalker
enemy.weakness: The Stamina Crystal temporarily nullifies the creature's invisibility when the player is in motion.

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered with shifting shadows that slow the player and reveal traps when stepped on.

pickup.name: Fang of the Jungle God
pickup.effect: A cursed blade that deals bonus damage to jungle creatures and can be used to break through magical barriers.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Stalker causes the temple to rumble and collapse, revealing the final boss chamber.

encounters.location: A massive stone altar at the heart of the jungle, surrounded by glowing moss and ancient carvings

enemy.name: The Jungle Guardian
enemy.weakness: The Fang of the Jungle God can temporarily weaken the guardian's magical barrier, allowing the player to strike true.

encounters.hazard: The altar emits a pulsing energy that causes the player to hallucinate, making it hard to distinguish friend from foe.

pickup.name: Crown of the Beastmaster
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's weapon damage and grants a temporary shield when the player is near their beast companion.

encounters.trigger: After the battle, the altar collapses, revealing a hidden passage that leads to the jungle’s edge.

boss.name: The Jungle Queen
boss.weakness: The Fang of the Jungle God must be used to break her magical barrier. Once broken, the player must use the Crown of the Beastmaster to protect their beast companion from her curse attacks.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jungle Queen with the combination of the Fang and the Crown, while maintaining the stamina boost from the Stamina Crystal.

level.objective: Navigate the jungle, survive the chaos of the terrain and the creatures, and defeat the Jungle Queen using the pickups you have collected throughout the level.
level.reward: A map to the next jungle region, and the ability to summon a beast companion in future levels.

level.setting: A dense, ancient rainforest with mist and unseen dangers

encounters.hazard: Toxic Vines (damage 10, 50% chance to trigger)

pickup.name: Luminous Moss
pickup.effect: Increases player's visibility in darkness by 50% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player steps into the mist, revealing the Jaguar's silhouette.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling (damage 30, triggers after 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Talisman of the Jaguar Spirit
pickup.effect: Unlocks a special bow ability: 'Spirit Shot' (one-time use, 50% chance to instantly kill enemy)

encounters.trigger: Player uses Luminous Moss to reveal hidden symbols on the cave walls, awakening the Hunter.

enemy.name: Jungle Warden (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Talisman of the Jaguar Spirit (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Mystic Roots (damage 25, 100% chance to trigger if player is near for more than 15 seconds)

pickup.name: Ancient Bow String
pickup.effect: Increases bow damage by 30% for the remainder of the level

encounters.trigger: Player steps into the center of the jungle where the Warden guards a sacred altar, sensing the Talisman's power.

boss.name: Jungle Warden
boss.weakness: Talisman of the Jaguar Spirit (pickup from prior encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden's mask using the Talisman-activated 'Spirit Shot'

level.objective: Reach the sacred altar and defeat the Jungle Warden, who guards the forest's ancient secrets.
level.reward: Ancient Bow String, unlocking new bow abilities for the player's weapon.

level.setting: Tropical rainforest with dense foliage, ancient ruins, and dangerous wildlife

encounters.location: Near the roots of an ancient tree

enemy.name: Shadow Viper
enemy.weakness: Poison resistance is reduced by the player's weapon, Shadow Dagger, if it has been upgraded with 'Venomous Tip' pickup

encounters.hazard: Poisonous vines that trigger a debuff if touched

pickup.name: Venomous Tip
pickup.effect: Upgrades the player's weapon to apply poison damage on hit

encounters.trigger: The viper's death triggers a hidden cave to open, revealing the next encounter's path

encounters.location: Inside a sealed cave with glowing moss and thorny traps

enemy.name: Giant Mangrove Warden
enemy.weakness: The player must be wielding the 'Venomous Tip' upgrade to bypass its natural armor

encounters.hazard: Thorny vines and pressure plates that trigger traps

pickup.name: Ancient Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a sealed passage to the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the warden, the Ancient Key is revealed, allowing access to the final boss area

encounters.location: Inside a grand, overgrown temple with stone pillars and a massive altar

enemy.name: Jungle God: Xel'quah
enemy.weakness: The player must use the 'Venomous Tip' upgrade on Xel'quah's eyes to weaken it and allow a critical strike

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and toxic mist that reduces player stamina

pickup.name: Jungle God's Crown
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary shield and increased critical strike chance

encounters.trigger: The Ancient Key triggers the final boss to awaken, and the player must use the Venomous Tip to proceed

boss.name: Jungle God: Xel'quah
boss.weakness: The player must use the 'Venomous Tip' upgrade on Xel'quah's eyes to weaken it and allow a critical strike
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Xel'quah and collect the 'Jungle God's Crown'

level.objective: Survive the jungle, defeat all enemies, and claim the power of the Jungle God
level.reward: Jungle God's Crown, a powerful relic that boosts the player's stealth and critical strike damage

level.setting: A lush, quiet rainforest with vibrant flora and distant bird calls. The air is thick with humidity and the scent of blooming flowers.

encounters.location: A hidden grove near a small waterfall.
encounters.hazard: A narrow, root-covered path that may cause player to fall if not careful.

pickup.name: Frost Bloom Seed
pickup.effect: When planted, it creates a temporary ice patch that slows enemies for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Crimson Fang, a glowing trail of frost leads the player deeper into the jungle.

encounters.location: A dense thicket with glowing fungi and mist that obscures vision.
encounters.hazard: Pillars of fire rise randomly and can burn the player if not avoided.

pickup.name: Thorned Vial
pickup.effect: When shattered, releases a burst of toxic gas that damages nearby enemies.

encounters.trigger: After planting the Frost Bloom Seed and defeating the Ember Viper, the ground begins to rumble and a path opens up leading to the final chamber.

encounters.location: A sacred jungle shrine surrounded by ancient stone carvings and a massive tree with glowing fruit.
encounters.hazard: The area is protected by a magical barrier that only activates when the Guardian is defeated.

pickup.name: Jungle Amulet
pickup.effect: Grants temporary immunity to all environmental hazards for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Guardian of the Grove emerges from the tree after the Thorned Vial is shattered, ending the level with a serene victory.

boss.name: Guardian of the Grove
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Guardian with the Thorned Vial to unlock the sacred tree's fruit, granting a powerful boon.

level.objective: Protect the sacred jungle by defeating the corrupted beasts and the Guardian of the Grove.
level.reward: Jungle Amulet (provides immunity to environmental hazards)

level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle teeming with life and decay. The air is thick with mist, and the cries of unseen creatures echo through the trees. The deeper you venture, the more the jungle seems to breathe and watch you.

encounters.location: A clearing with massive, gnarled roots twisted into grotesque shapes. The air smells of decay.
encounters.hazard: A thick fog reduces visibility and increases enemy detection speed.

pickup.name: Corrupted Root
pickup.effect: Increases player's attack power by 20% for 60 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Vinespirit triggers a deep rumble. A massive tree collapses, revealing a hidden path into the jungle's heart.

encounters.location: A circle of stone pillars covered in glowing, blood-red vines. Ritual symbols are carved into the ground.
encounters.hazard: The ground pulses with magical energy, causing random area-of-effect damage every 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Soulbound Totem
pickup.effect: Summons a temporary spirit ally for 90 seconds that deals 150 damage per second

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shaman, the totem begins to pulse with energy. A spectral figure emerges from the mist, heralding the final confrontation.

encounters.location: The heart of the jungle, a massive, pulsating tree with eyes glowing in the bark and a throne of bones at its base.
encounters.hazard: The tree emits periodic shockwaves that slow the player's movement and increase damage taken.

pickup.name: Eternal Spirit Core
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player's max health by 200

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden unlocks the spirit core, which absorbs the jungle’s essence. The jungle becomes silent, and the player is teleported back to the jungle’s edge with the core in hand.

boss.name: The Jungle Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden with the Soulbound Totem active to trigger a permanent healing effect and unlock the Eternal Spirit Core.

level.objective: Survive the jungle's deadly trials and defeat the Jungle Warden to escape with the Eternal Spirit Core and a new understanding of life and death.
level.reward: Eternal Spirit Core (permanent health boost), Soulbound Totem (temporary ally), Corrupted Root (temporary power boost)

encounters.location: Swirling Fog of the Forest Floor
encounters.hazard: Thick fog obscures vision, but the wisp is attracted to the alchemist's glowing potion flask.

pickup.name: Acid Splash Potion
pickup.effect: Inflicts 15 damage over 2 turns.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the wisp, a hidden path opens in the fog, revealing a glowing moss-covered archway leading deeper into the jungle.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and collapses occasionally, forcing the player to move carefully.

pickup.name: Glowing Moss
pickup.effect: Can be used to light the archway, revealing secret passages.

encounters.trigger: The golem is drawn to the alchemist's glowing potion flask, and when it is defeated, it leaves behind a patch of glowing moss.

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in shifting vines and ancient symbols that react to the player's presence.

pickup.name: Elixir of Clarity
pickup.effect: Restores 30 health and reduces all enemy damage by 50% for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: To activate the final boss, the player must use the glowing moss to light the archway, revealing the spirit's resting place.

boss.name: Jungle Guardian Spirit
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the spirit by using the glowing moss to weaken it, then finish it with a well-timed acid splash potion.

level.objective: Navigate through the jungle, using your alchemist skills to uncover hidden paths, defeat the three enemies, and finally face the guardian spirit with the tools you've collected along the way.

level.setting: dense, overgrown ruins hidden deep within a mist-covered rainforest, where time seems to flow unevenly

encounters.hazard: flickering lights and ghostly echoes of past travelers

pickup.name: Frozen Vial
pickup.effect: Freezes enemy for 3 seconds when used

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Jaguar, the Frozen Vial activates a hidden mechanism, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: mist that distorts time, causing the player to experience repeated moments

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Boosts Chrono Lance's time manipulation power by 30%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Stalkerman with the Frozen Vial allows the player to access the Chrono Core, which unlocks the final path to the boss.

encounters.location: the heart of the jungle, where the jungle's time is trapped
encounters.hazard: The battlefield shifts between past and future, confusing the player's perception of time

pickup.name: Eternal Time Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to rewind time for 5 seconds after the boss fight

encounters.trigger: The Chrono Core allows the player to manipulate the Time Warden's form, triggering the final confrontation.

boss.name: The Time Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Time Warden by using the Chrono Core to disrupt his time loops.

level.objective: Survive the eerie jungle and defeat the Time Warden, who is controlling the temporal anomalies in the region.
level.reward: Eternal Time Shard - allows the player to rewind time for 5 seconds, granting a second chance in critical moments.

level.setting: A desolate, overgrown jungle with thick fog, broken ruins, and a sense of ancient dread. The air is hot and thick with the smell of decay. Dead trees loom overhead, and strange, unnatural sounds echo in the distance.

encounters.hazard: The jaguar's claws leave behind glowing glyphs that temporarily reduce the player's movement speed.

pickup.name: Echo of the First Hunter
pickup.effect: Increases player damage by 10% for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the feral jaguar awakens a hidden stone tablet nearby, which pulses with an eerie light. This light draws the attention of the next enemy.

enemy.name: Cursed Viper
enemy.weakness: Echo of the First Hunter (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The viper's bite injects a slow poison that gradually reduces player health over time.

pickup.name: Soul of the Jungle Guardian
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of the player's health and grants temporary immunity to poison.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the viper, the player discovers a hidden shrine. The shrine activates a signal flare that draws the attention of the final, and most dangerous, enemy.

enemy.name: Jungle Warden
enemy.weakness: Soul of the Jungle Guardian (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The warden can summon vines to entangle the player, reducing their damage output by 50% for a short duration.

pickup.name: Crown of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final level of the jungle and grants permanent +15 damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jungle Warden reveals a hidden path through the thickest part of the jungle, where the player finds the Crown of the Jungle and exits the level.

boss.name: The Maw of the Jungle
boss.weakness: Crown of the Jungle (pickup from prior encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Maw to escape the desolate jungle, now forever changed by the player's passage.

level.objective: Survive the jungle, uncover ancient secrets, and escape with your life.
level.reward: Crown of the Jungle (permanent damage boost) and a permanent upgrade to player's armor (resistance to environmental hazards).
